mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% indicates labor market tightening that boosts corporate profit margins through wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and deceleration in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates strong real demand without inflationary pressure, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days via sustainable economic growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises and CPIAUCSL falls, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion phases with GDP growth above 2.5% annualized, S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over 60 trading days as investors price in sustained earnings momentum before cyclical slowdown.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% annualized for 3 consecutive quarters, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index base 2017=100) signals manufacturing weakness that triggers central bank intervention expectations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0 for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals inflationary pressure that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as higher rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing starts above 1.2 million units annually indicates strong consumer demand for housing, correlating with broader economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1.2 million units annually, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
